response.overview: Between the turmoil of Syria and the velvet curtains of the Stuttgart State Theater lies a journey of thousands of miles - and memories of the Balkan route that time cannot blur. Hamed arrived in 2015, a stranger to the language, yet destined to help shape the city's visual soul. Today, he works in the quiet magic of the scenic painting studios, where art comes to life behind the scenes. While he paints grand worlds for the stage, his private canvas remains a sanctuary for the one thing no brushstroke can hide: the vivid, indelible images of a home that stays with him.
response.title: Path to Peace
